entries.jp:
舞台にいた
新選組の面々は
観客と同じように
倒れていた
entries.en:
The Shinsengumi
members on the
stage had
collapsed, just
like the audience.

entries.jp: うう……\n僕はいったい……
entries.en: Ugh... What...\nhappened to\nme...?

entries.jp: なんだ……\n体が……重くて……\n動かない……
entries.en:
What's... wrong...
My body's... so
heavy... I can't
move...

entries.jp: 気が遠く……なりそう
entries.en: I feel like... I'm\ngoing to pass\nout...

entries.jp: かろうじて生きているのか\n生きているのなら\nまだ使い道はある
entries.en:
So he's barely
alive, is he? Well,
if he lives, he still
has his uses.

entries.jp: シャンとするんじゃ\nソウちん！\n気を失ったらいかん！
entries.en:
Pull yourself
together, So-chin!
Don't you dare
pass out!

entries.jp: トサカくん……
entries.en: Tosaka-kun...

entries.jp: ええか　ソウちん\nしっかり聞いてくれ
entries.en: Listen, So-chin.\nHear me out, now.

entries.jp: 良い心も　悪い心も\nどっちも人の心じゃ
entries.en:
A good heart and
a wicked heart...
they're both
human hearts.

entries.jp: 苦しみを　悲しみを\n背負って生きていくのは\n誰だって辛い
entries.en:
Livin' while
carryin' pain and
sadness is hard
on anybody.

entries.jp: でも　それを分かち合い\n癒すために\nわしらは歌うんじゃろ
entries.en:
But that's why we
sing, ain't it? To
share that load
and heal it.

entries.jp: ソウちんの悲しみを\nわしにも　ちぃとばかり\n背負わせてくれんか？
entries.en:
So-chin, won't you
let me carry just a
little bit of your
sadness too?

entries.jp: 代わりにわしのバカを\nソウちんにも分けて\nやるぜよ……
entries.en:
In exchange, I'll
share some of my
foolishness with
you, So-chin...

entries.jp: だから\n目を覚ますぜよ\nソウちん！
entries.en: So wake up,\nSo-chin!

entries.jp: 僕は……\n歌の力に酔いしれて\n取り込まれてた……
entries.en:
I... got drunk on
the power of the
song... and it
swallowed me
up...

entries.jp: トサカくんのおかげで\n少し……歌う\n喜びを……思い出したよ
entries.en:
Thanks to you,
Tosaka-kun... I
remembered... a
little of the joy of
singing.

entries.jp: そうじゃ\nそれでこそソウちんじゃ
entries.en: That's it! That's\nthe So-chin I\nknow!

entries.jp: 僕の歌う歌が\n土方さんや近藤さんに\n役立つ……
entries.en:
I thought the
songs I sang...
would help
Hijikata-san and
Kondo-san...

entries.jp: ……あの人たちの\n理想の世界に役立つ……\nそう　思っていたのに……
entries.en:
...would help build
the world they
dreamed of...
That's what I
believed...

entries.jp: いつのまに……\n間違った……\nの……かな
entries.en: When did I... go...\nwrong...?

entries.jp: おいっ　ソウちん！\nしっかりしろ！\nおいっ！
entries.en: Hey, So-chin!\nHang in there!\nHey!

entries.jp: …………\n僕はもうダメだよ……
entries.en: ...... I'm done for...

entries.jp: トサカくんの言う通りだ…\n僕の魂は　負の力に\n汚されてた……ごふっ
entries.en:
You were right,
Tosaka-kun... My
soul... was tainted
by negative
power... *Cough!*

entries.jp: しっかりしろ　ソウちん！\nわしが助けるぜよ！\n気を強く持つんじゃ！
entries.en:
Hang in there,
So-chin! I'm gonna
save you! Stay
strong!

entries.jp: もう　僕の魂は……天歌に\n吸い尽くされ……た
entries.en:
My soul's
already... been
drained dry... by
Heaven's Song...

entries.jp: 最後に……思い出せて\n良かった……\nなぜ……歌いたかったか…
entries.en:
At least... at the
end... I'm glad I
remembered...
why... I wanted to
sing...

entries.jp: ソウちんはオッサンや\nヒジゾーさんの\n役に立ちたかった……
entries.en:
So-chin, you
wanted to be
useful to the old
man and
Hijizo-san...

entries.jp: だからソウちんは\n天歌を歌っていたんじゃ
entries.en:
That's why you
were singin'
Heaven's Song,
So-chin.

entries.jp: 天歌が人を救うと\n信じていたんじゃろ？
entries.en:
You believed
Heaven's Song
would save
people, didn't ya?

entries.jp: トサカくん……
entries.en: Tosaka-kun...

entries.jp: その想いを利用した奴が\nまことの悪人じゃ！
entries.en: The one who used\nthose feelin's is\nthe real villain!

entries.jp: お前じゃ！\n井伊直弼！
entries.en: That's you!\nNaosuke Ii!

entries.jp: 沖田を懐柔して\n勝ったつもりか
entries.en:
You win Okita
over, and now
you think you've
won?

entries.jp:
龍馬が指差した
その先には
薄笑いを浮かべた
井伊直弼の姿があった
entries.en:
At the end of
Ryoma's pointing
finger stood
Naosuke Ii, a thin
smile on his lips.

entries.jp: 沖田を潰して\n我を悪人呼ばわりか
entries.en: You crush Okita,\nand then call me\nthe villain?

entries.jp: 純粋な人の心を……\n人の魂を利用する外道！
entries.en:
Usin' a pure
heart... usin'
people's souls...
you scum!

entries.jp: お前こそが\nまことの悪党じゃ！
entries.en: You're the real\nvillain here!

entries.jp: ふふ\n面白い事を言うのだね\n坂本龍馬
entries.en:
Heh. What an
amusing thing to
say, Ryoma
Sakamoto.

entries.jp: お前はソウちんを\n新選組を利用しただけじゃ
entries.en: All you did was\nuse So-chin and\nthe Shinsengumi!

entries.jp: ほほう\n利用して\nいけないのかな
entries.en:
Oh ho. And is
there something
wrong with using
them?

entries.jp: 井伊直弼！\nわしがお前の性根を\n叩き直してやる
entries.en:
Naosuke Ii! I'm
gonna beat that
rotten attitude
outta you!

entries.jp: ふふ　大口を叩く\n出来るものなら\nやってみろ　小僧
entries.en: Heh. Big talk. Try\nit if you can, boy.

entries.jp:
難を逃れた新選組や
警護の武士たち
観客の何人かが
立ち上がった
entries.en:
The Shinsengumi
members who had
escaped harm,
the guard
samurai, and
some of the
spectators rose to
their feet.

entries.jp: うお　なんじゃ？
entries.en: Whoa, what the?

entries.jp: 龍馬くん　気を付けて！\n彼らは井伊の術に\n落ちているみたいだ！
entries.en:
Ryoma-kun, be
careful! They
seem to have
fallen under Ii's
spell!

entries.jp: ヤベェな\n囲まれちまったぜ
entries.en: Damn, we're\nsurrounded!

entries.jp: ど　どうしよう？\nお客さんもおるぞ
entries.en:
Wh-what do we
do? There's
audience folks in
there too!

entries.jp: 井伊に操られているなら\n新選組も観客もないぜ\n今は生きる屍だからな
entries.en:
If Ii's controlling
them, it doesn't
matter if they're
Shinsengumi or
audience. Right
now they're the
walking dead.

entries.jp: 残念だけど\n全てが敵と考えないと\nいけないだろうね
entries.en:
I'm afraid we'll
have to treat
every one of them
as an enemy.

entries.jp: いや　違うと思う\n倒すべき敵はただ一人\n井伊だけじゃ
entries.en:
Nah, I don't think
so. There's only
one enemy we
gotta beat: Ii.

entries.jp: 井伊に操られた\n新選組やお客さんは\n敵ではないじゃろ
entries.en:
The Shinsengumi
and the audience
Ii's controllin' ain't
our enemies.

entries.jp: じゃあどうすんだよ！
entries.en: Then what are we\nsupposed to do!?

entries.jp: わしが歌で圧し返す\nその間　二人に\n頼みたいことがある
entries.en:
I'll push 'em back
with my song.
Meanwhile,
there's somethin' I
need you two to
do.

entries.jp: なんだい\n龍馬くん？
entries.en: What is it,\nRyoma-kun?

entries.jp: ソウちんを\n二人に任せたい
entries.en: I want you two to\nlook after So-chin.

entries.jp: おいおい　龍馬\nなにをするつもりだ？
entries.en: Whoa, whoa,\nRyoma. What are\nyou planning?

entries.jp: わしは井伊を倒す！
entries.en: I'm gonna take\ndown Ii!

entries.jp: バカヤロウ！\n一人で井伊に立ち向かう\nつもりかよ！
entries.en:
You moron!
You're going to
take on Ii by
yourself!?

entries.jp: 井伊に一発食らわせにゃ\nどうあっても許せん！
entries.en:
I can't forgive
him, no matter
what, till I land a
punch on Ii!

entries.jp: ……わかった\nオレ様に任せとけ
entries.en: ...Fine. Leave it to\nyours truly.

entries.jp: 井伊が放った者が\n龍馬達を囲むように\nにじり寄ってくる
entries.en:
The people Ii had
unleashed inched
closer, as if to
surround Ryoma
and the others.

entries.jp: 行くぞっ！\nオレ様の歌で圧し返して\nやるっ！
entries.en:
Here we go! I'll
push you back
with the great
Takasugi's song!

entries.jp: わわっ　晋作\n人数が多すぎですよ！
entries.en:
Whoa, whoa,
Shinsaku! There
are way too many
of them!

entries.jp: 井伊が操ってる連中は\n化け物か\nぜんぜん効かねえ！
entries.en:
Are the guys Ii's
controlling
monsters or
something!? It's
not working at all!

entries.jp: まずい　晋作！\n沖田くんの息がっ！
entries.en:
Bad news,
Shinsaku!
Okita-kun's
breathing is...!

entries.jp: 沖田を死なせるなっ！
entries.en: Don't let Okita\ndie!

entries.jp: ふふふ　沖田よ\nまだ仕事は\n終わってはおらんぞ
entries.en:
Heh heh heh.
Okita, your work
is not finished
yet.

entries.jp: 井伊！\nもうやめろ！
entries.en: Ii! Stop it already!

entries.jp: もう瀕死なんじゃ\nソウちんが\n死んでしまう！
entries.en:
He's already at
death's door!
So-chin's gonna
die!

entries.jp: それがどうした？\n沖田が死んだところで\n代わりはいくらでもいる
entries.en:
And what of it?
Even if Okita
dies, there are
plenty more to
replace him.

entries.jp: 貴様！\nどこまで外道なんじゃ\nいくらなんでも許せん！
entries.en:
You...! How low
can you sink!?
This is beyond
forgivin'!

entries.jp: おやおや\n悪も受け入れると言った\nあの言葉は嘘だったのか？
entries.en:
My, my. So those
words about
accepting evil too
were a lie?

entries.jp: これからする悪事は\n止めるに決まっとる\n井伊！
entries.en:
Evil you're about
to commit, I'm
gonna stop, plain
and simple, Ii!

entries.jp: いい度胸だ　小僧\nしかし仲間の心配をする\n方が先ではないのかな？
entries.en:
Plucky, boy. But
shouldn't you be
worrying about
your comrades
first?

entries.jp: 仲間っ
entries.en: My friends!

entries.jp: 晋作っ
entries.en: Shinsaku!

entries.jp: ぐふっ……\n……すまねぇ　桂さん　\n隙を見せちまった
entries.en: Ugh... Sorry,\nKatsura-san... I let\nmy guard down.

entries.jp: 龍馬が井伊に気を取られた\n隙を突いて　数人の観客が\n高杉を襲ったのだ
entries.en:
While Ryoma was
distracted by Ii,
several spectators
had seized the
opening to attack
Takasugi.

entries.jp: シンディ！\nしっかりしろ！
entries.en: Shindy! Hang in\nthere!

entries.jp: 我と対峙している最中に\n背を向けるとは\n行け　傀儡共よ
entries.en:
Turning your
back on me while
we're face to
face? Go, my
puppets.

entries.jp: あぶねえ　龍馬っ！
entries.en: Look out, Ryoma!

entries.jp: うぐっ……
entries.en: Ugh...

entries.jp: 我の前で\n余裕を見せるなど\n詰めが甘すぎる
entries.en:
Acting so
carefree in front
of me... How very
careless.

entries.jp: すまねえ龍馬……\nオレ様のせいで\nお前まで
entries.en: Sorry, Ryoma...\nBecause of me,\nyou got hit too.

entries.jp: シンディのせいじゃない\nわしが悪いんじゃ……\nぐうっ……
entries.en: It ain't your fault,\nShindy. It's mine...\nNgh...

entries.jp: 龍馬くん　大変だ！\n沖田くんが！
entries.en: Ryoma-kun, this\nis bad! Okita-kun\nis...!

entries.jp: ソウちんがどうし……
entries.en: What's wrong\nwith So-chin...

entries.jp:
言いかけて口ごもった
龍馬の前には
あの美しい沖田の姿はなく
沖田だったものがあった
entries.en:
Ryoma's words
died in his throat.
Before him was
not the beautiful
Okita, but what
had once been
Okita.

entries.jp: ソウちん！
entries.en: So-chin!

entries.jp: あああ\n井伊の術に落ちて……
entries.en: Ahh... He's fallen\nunder Ii's spell...

entries.jp: ぐぐぐ……\nぐがぁぁああああああっ
entries.en: Grrr...\nGWAAAAAAH!

entries.jp: ほう　これは面白い\n我が術で魂をゆがめると\n容姿までゆがむのか
entries.en:
Oh ho, how
interesting. When
my art warps the
soul, the body
warps as well?

entries.jp: これは素晴らしい\n美しい姿だよ\n沖田
entries.en: This is splendid.\nWhat a beautiful\nform, Okita.

entries.jp: ふふふ……\nもっと美しい姿を見せて\nもらおうか　沖田
entries.en:
Heh heh heh...
Now, show me an
even more
beautiful form,
Okita.

entries.jp: それは美しい……\n化け物になりたまえ！
entries.en: Become a\nbeautiful...\nmonster!

entries.jp: しっかり！\n気をしっかり持て\nソウちん！
entries.en: Hang on! Stay\nstrong, So-chin!

entries.jp: だめだ　龍馬くん！\n沖田くんの耳には\nもう言葉は届かない！
entries.en:
It's no use,
Ryoma-kun!
Words can't reach
Okita-kun
anymore!

entries.jp: 言葉がダメでも\n歌なら　きっと\n心に届くっ！
entries.en:
Words might not
work, but a song'll
reach his heart
for sure!

entries.jp: ぐおおぉるるる……
entries.en: Grooaaarrrrr...

entries.jp: ソウちん\nわしの歌を聴いてくれ
entries.en: So-chin, listen to\nmy song.

entries.jp: ロックで元の\nソウちんに戻ろうな\nなあ　ソウちん
entries.en:
Let's get you back
to your old self
with rock, okay?
Okay, So-chin?

entries.jp: がううっ
entries.en: Gwrrh!

entries.jp: うがあっ
entries.en: Graah!

entries.jp: 龍馬くんっ！\n沖田くんはもう理性が\n残っていない！
entries.en: Ryoma-kun!\nOkita-kun has no\nreason left!

entries.jp: くうっ……まだだ　まだ\nわしは諦めない！　だから\nソウちんも絶対
entries.en:
Ngh... Not yet!
Not yet! I ain't
givin' up! So you,
So-chin, don't you
ever...

entries.jp: 諦めるなぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！
entries.en: ...give uuuuuuup!

entries.jp:
圧倒的な力を放つ沖田に
吹き飛ばされた龍馬は
それでも這うようにして
沖田を説得しようとあがく
entries.en:
Blown away by
the overwhelming
power Okita
unleashed, Ryoma
still crawled
forward,
struggling to get
through to him.

entries.jp: 舞台の上は\n井伊に操られた\n観客達が押し寄せる
entries.en:
Onto the stage
surged the
spectators under
Ii's control.

entries.jp: くそっ　後がねえ
entries.en: Dammit, we're\ncornered.

entries.jp: ががあっ……\nぐがあああ！
entries.en: Gagahh...\nGRAAAAH!

entries.jp: 井伊に操られて\n魂を縛られたんじゃ\nソウちん……
entries.en:
Ii's controllin'
you... He's got
your soul in
chains, So-chin...

entries.jp: ぐがあぁっ……\nがるうう
entries.en: Grraahh... Grrrr...

entries.jp: 哀しいだろな\n苦しいだろな\nつらいよな　ソウちん
entries.en:
It must be sad. It
must hurt. It's
rough, ain't it,
So-chin?

entries.jp: ぐる……\nがああああっ！
entries.en: Grr... GWAAAAH!

entries.jp: わしを食って\n魂が解放されるなら\nそれもええ……
entries.en:
If eatin' me sets
your soul free...
then that's fine by
me...

entries.jp: 龍馬は\n覚悟を決めたように\n双眸を閉じた――
entries.en:
As if he had made
up his mind,
Ryoma closed his
eyes--

entries.jp: 総司！\nオレの声が聞こえるか！
entries.en: Soji! Can you hear\nmy voice!?

entries.jp: が　ぐるる……
entries.en: Gah... grrr...

entries.jp: オレだ\n近藤だ　総司\n聞こえているな？
entries.en: It's me. It's Kondo,\nSoji. You can hear\nme, can't you?

entries.jp: 遅くなってすまない　\n総司……お前を\n辛い目に合わせたな
entries.en: Sorry I'm late,\nSoji... I put you\nthrough so much.

entries.jp: 近藤のオッサン\n今までどこに？
entries.en: Old man Kondo!\nWhere've you\nbeen all this time?

entries.jp: 総司を利用するので\n邪魔だったのだろう\n閉じこめられていたんだ
entries.en:
I suppose I was in
the way of their
plans to use Soji. I
was locked up.

entries.jp: ふふ……あれだけ何重にも\n閉じこめたのに破るとは\nさすが新選組の局長か
entries.en:
Heh... I sealed you
away so many
times over, and
yet you broke
free. As expected
of the
Shinsengumi's
Commander.

entries.jp: トシもいることを\n忘れたのかい\n井伊大老
entries.en: Did you forget\nabout Toshi,\nGreat Elder Ii?

entries.jp: ヒジゾーさんは
entries.en: What about\nHijizo-san?

entries.jp: オレを先に行かせるために\n警備の武士達と戦っている
entries.en:
He's fighting the
guard samurai so
I could go on
ahead.

entries.jp: ほお　たかが手駒の分際で\n愉快な茶番を見せてくれる
entries.en:
Oh ho. Mere
pawns, putting on
such an amusing
farce for me.

entries.jp: 総司を利用し尽くした\n貴方を許しはしない\nだが　今は
entries.en:
I will never
forgive you for
using Soji up. But
right now...

entries.jp: てめえなんぞに関わるより\n総司の方が大切だ
entries.en:
...Soji matters
more than
dealing with the
likes of you.

entries.jp:
近藤の姿はボロボロだった
ここに来るために
どれだけ戦ったのか
その姿で　理解できる
entries.en:
Kondo was
battered and torn.
One look told how
hard he had
fought to get
here.

entries.jp: 近藤は直弼に背を向け\n化け物と化した総司を\n力の限り　抱きしめる
entries.en:
Turning his back
on Naosuke,
Kondo hugged
Soji, now a
monster, with all
his might.

entries.jp: そして　歌い出す\n魂の慟哭だった
entries.en:
And then he
began to sing. It
was the wail of
his soul.

entries.jp:
けれどその歌は悲しみ
ではなく愛しい者へ
捧げるどこまでも
優しい歌……
entries.en:
Yet it was not a
song of sorrow,
but an endlessly
gentle song
offered to
someone dear...

entries.jp: ぐ　ぐぐ……\n……さん……
entries.en: Ngh... ngh...\n...san...

entries.jp: 総司……\nおまえはこれまで\nよくやってくれた
entries.en: Soji... You've done\nso well all this\ntime.

entries.jp: オレの大切な総司……
entries.en: My precious Soji...

entries.jp: ……さん……\n近藤……さん……
entries.en: ...san... Kondo...\nsan...

entries.jp: ああ　オレだよ総司
entries.en: Yes, it's me, Soji.

entries.jp: 大丈夫だ\nどんな姿になっても\n総司は総司だからな
entries.en:
It's all right. No
matter what you
look like, Soji is
Soji.

entries.jp: 総司が戻ってくるまで\n何度でも歌うぞ\nオレの魂を震わせてな
entries.en:
I'll sing as many
times as it takes
until you come
back, Soji. With
my soul shaking!

entries.jp: 黒い気が沖田くんから\n離れて　近藤さんを\n襲っている
entries.en:
The black energy
is leaving
Okita-kun and
attacking
Kondo-san!

entries.jp: ソウちんの意思とは\n無関係に井伊の術で\n動いているんじゃ！
entries.en:
It's movin' on Ii's
spell, no matter
what So-chin
wants!

entries.jp: このままでは\n近藤さんが\n危ないですよ！
entries.en: At this rate,\nKondo-san is in\ndanger!

entries.jp: 無茶はいかんっ！\nオッサンの魂を黒い気が\n狙っている！
entries.en:
Don't push it! The
black energy's
after your soul,
old man!

entries.jp: いいんだ\nオレの魂で総司を救える\nのなら安いもんだ　ぐふっ
entries.en:
It's all right. If my
soul can save Soji,
it's a small price
to pay. *Cough!*

entries.jp: ……どれだけでも　オレを\n攻撃すればいい……っ
entries.en: ...Attack me... as\nmuch as you\nlike...!

entries.jp: それだけ　総司は……\n井伊の気から解放される\nがはっ……
entries.en:
The more you
do... the more Soji
is freed from Ii's
energy... *Gahh!*

entries.jp: ダメぜよっ！\nあんたが命を無くしたら\nソウちんが悲しむぜよ！
entries.en:
No way! If you
lose your life,
So-chin's gonna
grieve!

entries.jp:
龍馬の叫びに
応えることなく
近藤は沖田に
語りかける
entries.en:
Without
answering
Ryoma's cry,
Kondo spoke to
Okita.

entries.jp: なあ　総司\nオレ達の出会いから\n今日までのこと
entries.en:
Hey, Soji.
Everything from
the day we met
until today...

entries.jp: 覚えてるか……
entries.en: ...do you\nremember it?

entries.jp: ……ええ……\n近藤……さん
entries.en: ...Yes... Kondo...\nsan...

entries.jp: 辛い思いをさせてしまい\n済まなかったな
entries.en: I'm sorry I put\nyou through so\nmuch pain.

entries.jp: 元の姿に戻してやる\n安心しろ　総司
entries.en: I'll bring you back\nto your old self.\nDon't worry, Soji.

entries.jp: あた……たかい……\nあたたかい……です\n近藤さん……
entries.en: It's... warm... So\nwarm...\nKondo-san...

entries.jp: それは\n不思議な光景だった
entries.en: It was a strange\nsight.

entries.jp:
黒い気に　囲まれ
攻撃されているのに
じんわりとした光が
二人の姿を
浮かびあがらせる
entries.en:
Though the black
energy
surrounded and
attacked them, a
gentle glow made
the two of them
stand out.

entries.jp: なんでじゃ？\nこの光……は\nわしの魂を震わせるぜよ
entries.en: What the? This\nlight... it's makin'\nmy soul tremble!

entries.jp: 私の魂も\n震えていますよ
entries.en: My soul is\ntrembling too.

entries.jp: オレ様もだぜ\nどういうこった
entries.en: Same for yours\ntruly. What's\ngoing on?

entries.jp:
近藤が歌うと　合わせる
ように光が瞬くのが見える
うっすらとした光は
その強さを徐々に
増しているようだった
entries.en:
Whenever Kondo
sang, the light
could be seen
flickering in time.
The faint glow
seemed to grow
stronger little by
little.

entries.jp: 近藤さ……ん\n僕の魂が……\n暖かく……
entries.en: Kondo-san... My\nsoul... feels...\nwarm...

entries.jp: そのままじっとしていろ\n総司　オレが助けてやる\nからな……
entries.en: Just stay still,\nSoji. I'll save you...

entries.jp: 近藤はまた歌う\n愛しいと告げるように\nそして光は輝きを増した
entries.en:
Kondo sang
again, as if
telling Soji how
dear he was. And
the light grew
brighter.

entries.jp: ……これは……まさか\n超魂の欠片か？\n未だ見つからないひとつ
entries.en:
...This is... could it
be... a fragment
of the Ultra Soul?
The one piece
still not found...

entries.jp: こんなところ\n目と鼻の先に\n落ちていたと言うのか
entries.en:
You mean to say
it was lying right
here, under my
very nose?

entries.jp: これは　片魂の光！
entries.en: This is the light\nof a Piece Soul!

entries.jp: おいっ　新選組は沖田だけ\nじゃなくて　もう一個\n持ってたってのかよ！
entries.en:
Hey! You're
telling me the
Shinsengumi had
another one
besides Okita's!?

entries.jp: 今まで　眠っていた\nのでしょうね\n私の時のように……
entries.en:
It must have been
dormant until
now. Just like
mine was...

entries.jp: ソウちんの片魂の汚れが\n消えていく……けど\nこのままじゃ……
entries.en:
The taint's fadin'
from So-chin's
Piece Soul... but at
this rate...

entries.jp:
沖田に差しだすように
無防備な魂と片魂は
黒い気の攻撃の的であり
沖田の消滅しかけた魂が
すがり　すすり込む砂漠の
水のようなものだった
entries.en:
Kondo's soul and
Piece Soul lay
bare, offered up
to Okita: the black
energy's target,
and desert water
for his fading
soul to drink in.

entries.jp: なんとか　できねえのか\nせめて　あの黒いのを\nこっちに引き寄せる手とか
entries.en:
Can't we do
something? At
least some way to
draw that black
stuff over to us?

entries.jp: はははははは……\nこれはこれは　丁度いい\n滅してしまうがよい！
entries.en:
Ha ha ha ha ha
ha... Well, well,
how convenient.
Perish, then!

entries.jp: 沖田の片魂も　近藤の\n片魂も　ここで庇いあって\n消えてしまう
entries.en:
Okita's Piece Soul
and Kondo's Piece
Soul, shielding
each other, will
vanish right here.

entries.jp: 悲壮な\n喜劇じゃあありませんか
entries.en: Isn't that a tragic\ncomedy?

entries.jp: なんだとっ！
entries.en: What did you\nsay!?

entries.jp: 貴方がたに礼を\n言いたいくらいですよ\nふはははは
entries.en: I almost want to\nthank you all. Fu\nha ha ha ha!

entries.jp: がふっ……ぐぅっ
entries.en: Gahh... Nghh...

entries.jp: ダメ……だよ　近藤さん\n近藤さんの魂が……\n食われてしまう……
entries.en:
Don't...
Kondo-san... Your
soul will... get
devoured...

entries.jp: 構わん……\nいいんだ
entries.en: I don't care... It's\nall right.

entries.jp: いかんっ\nオッサンの魂が\n消えかけている！
entries.en: No good! The old\nman's soul is\nfadin' away!

entries.jp: そこまでじゃ！　\nもう　ここでやめて\nおくんじゃ！　オッサン
entries.en: That's enough!\nStop right here,\nold man!

entries.jp: ここから逃げて生き延びて\nゆっくりと養生したら\nソウちんも元に戻る！
entries.en:
Get outta here,
survive, rest up
nice and slow,
and So-chin'll get
back to normal
too!

entries.jp: オッサンが死んだら\nソウちんが泣くぜよ\nもうやめるぜよ
entries.en:
If you die, old
man, So-chin's
gonna cry! Stop it
already!

entries.jp: 総司……\nオレは先に行っている
entries.en: Soji... I'll go on\nahead.

entries.jp: 死んだ仲間達のところへ\n詫びに行かないとな……
entries.en: I have to go\napologize to our\nfallen comrades...

entries.jp: おまえは……\nゆっくりと……
entries.en: You... take your\ntime...

entries.jp: オレのずっと後から――
entries.en: ...and follow long,\nlong after me--

entries.jp: \fnt1うあああ\nオッサン！\fnt0
entries.en: \fnt1Waaaah! Old\nmaaan!\fnt0

entries.jp:
事切れた近藤と
引き替えに
沖田の体が元へと
戻ってゆく
entries.en:
In exchange for
Kondo, who had
breathed his last,
Okita's body
returned to its
original form.

entries.jp: 総司っ！\n近藤さんっ！
entries.en: Soji! Kondo-san!

entries.jp:
近藤を先に沖田の元へと
行かせ　ずっと井伊の操る
者達と戦い続けたのだろう
土方は傷つき　血まみれで
荒い息をしながら現れた
entries.en:
Having sent
Kondo on to
Okita, Hijikata
must have fought
Ii's puppets all
along. He arrived
wounded,
bloodied, gasping.

entries.jp: ヒジゾーさん……
entries.en: Hijizo-san...

entries.jp: 総司はっ\n無事なのか\n近藤さんはっ！
entries.en: Is Soji safe!? And\nKondo-san!?

entries.jp: 沖田くんは　近藤さんが\n助けて……まだ　息がある\nけれど近藤さんは……
entries.en:
Kondo-san saved
Okita-kun... he's
still breathing.
But Kondo-san...

entries.jp: 悲痛に首を振る桂に\n土方の顔色が変わる
entries.en:
Katsura shook his
head in anguish,
and the color
drained from
Hijikata's face.

entries.jp: ふふふ　遅かったな　土方\nせっかく　辿りついたと\nいうのに　気の毒なことよ
entries.en:
Heh heh heh. Too
late, Hijikata.
After all the
trouble of getting
here, how very
unfortunate for
you.

entries.jp: 井伊っ！
entries.en: Ii!

entries.jp: 我を呼び捨てとは\n偉くなったものだな\n反逆者めが
entries.en:
Calling me by
name without a
title? You've
gotten rather full
of yourself,
traitor.

entries.jp:
……なんなんだ……
これはなんなんだよ！
俺が先に駆けつければ……
もっと早く……もっと……
entries.en:
...What is this...
What the hell is
this!? If I'd gotten
here first... If I'd
been faster... If
only...

entries.jp: どちらが先でも\n結果は同じだ　土方\n裏切り者は死ぬ定めだ
entries.en:
It makes no
difference who
arrived first,
Hijikata. Traitors
are fated to die.

entries.jp:
井伊は勝ち誇った
ような目で
事切れた近藤と
その亡骸に抱きしめられ
倒れた沖田を見下す
entries.en:
With triumphant
eyes, Ii looked
down on Kondo,
who had breathed
his last, and on
Okita, lying in the
dead man's
embrace.

entries.jp: 井伊　お前だけは……\nどうあっても許せんっ！
entries.en: Ii... You, I can\nnever forgive, no\nmatter what!

entries.jp: はははは\n口だけは達者なようだが\nなにが出来るのだね？
entries.en:
Ha ha ha ha. You
certainly talk a
good game, but
what can you
actually do?

entries.jp:
ただ　沖田が化け物の
姿から元に戻っただけで
井伊に操られた民たちも
黒く蠢く気も残っている
龍馬たちに勝ち目は
なかった
entries.en:
Okita was merely
back from his
monster form; Ii's
puppets and the
writhing black
energy remained.
Ryoma's side had
no chance.

entries.jp: くっそぉ！
entries.en: Daaammit!

entries.jp: 我は機嫌がいい\n別れの挨拶ぐらいは\n見逃してやろうか
entries.en:
I am in a good
mood. Perhaps I'll
overlook a
farewell or two.

entries.jp: 些細な力で\nあがくがいい　\nふははははははっ
entries.en:
Struggle with
your paltry
strength all you
like. Fu ha ha ha
ha ha!

entries.jp:
高笑いを上げた井伊に
龍馬達は唇を噛む
だが
土方は井伊を無視し
舞台へと駆け上がる
entries.en:
As Ii laughed out
loud, Ryoma and
the others bit
their lips. But
Hijikata ignored
Ii and ran up onto
the stage.

entries.jp: なあ　近藤さん
entries.en: Hey, Kondo-san.

entries.jp: 近藤さんも\n総司も失ったら\n俺はどうなるんだ？
entries.en:
If I lose you and
Soji both,
Kondo-san, what
becomes of me?

entries.jp: 失うわけにはいかないっ\n逝かせるわけには\nいかねえんだっ
entries.en: I can't lose you! I\nwon't let you go!

entries.jp: 近藤さんが……\n近藤さんが死ぬなんて\n冗談だろう　なあ総司
entries.en:
Kondo-san...
Kondo-san dead?
That's a joke,
right? Right, Soji?

entries.jp: 総司　お前まで死ぬなんて\n絶対に許さないぞ！
entries.en: Soji, I will never\nforgive you if you\ndie too!

entries.jp: ひ……じ……\nかた……さん
entries.en: Hiji... ka... ta...\nsan...

entries.jp: 近藤の亡骸を抱きしめて\n堪えるように男泣きをする\n土方に龍馬達の胸が詰まる
entries.en:
Hijikata clutched
Kondo's body and
wept like a man
holding back his
tears, and Ryoma
and the others
felt their chests
tighten.

entries.jp: 一つですむ命を二つ\n捨てるとは　愚かなことよ
entries.en:
Throwing away
two lives when
one would have
done. How
foolish.

entries.jp: もっとも……\n取るにたらん命だがな\nハハハハハハ
entries.en:
Mind you... they're
worthless lives
anyway. Ha ha ha
ha ha ha!

entries.jp: 不敵な笑みを露わに\nした井伊は蔀の奥へと\n姿を消した
entries.en:
Baring a fearless
smile, Ii vanished
behind the lattice
shutters.

entries.jp: 龍馬達は\n井伊が去ったことを\n知る由もなく
entries.en:
Ryoma and the
others had no
way of knowing
that Ii had left.

entries.jp: 近藤の亡骸を\nかき抱いて泣く\n土方と――
entries.en:
They only
watched over
Hijikata, weeping
as he held
Kondo's body
close--

entries.jp: その傍らに\n佇む沖田の姿を\n見守っていた
entries.en: --and Okita,\nstanding silently\nbeside him.

entries.jp: 近藤さん……\nなあ　起きてくれ\nもう一度俺を殴ってくれよ
entries.en:
Kondo-san... Come
on, wake up. Hit
me one more
time.

entries.jp: あの時……\n俺は雨の中\n立ち尽くしていた
entries.en: That time... I was\nstanding frozen\nin the rain.

entries.jp: トシ……
entries.en: Toshi...

entries.jp: あと二人
entries.en: Two more.

entries.jp: トシ！
entries.en: Toshi!

entries.jp: 近藤さん……\nどうしてここに？
entries.en: Kondo-san... What\nare you doing\nhere?

entries.jp: お前の様子が\nおかしかったからな\n後をつけたのよ
entries.en: You were acting\nstrange, so I\nfollowed you.

entries.jp: 見ていたのか……
entries.en: You saw, then...

entries.jp: 間に合わなかったがな
entries.en: Not in time to\nstop you, though.

entries.jp: そいつらか
entries.en: So these are the\nones?

entries.jp: あと二人だ\n行方がわからない\nやつがいる
entries.en: Two more. There\nare some I haven't\ntracked down yet.

entries.jp: トシよ\n復讐のための剣なぞ\n俺は教えちゃいねぇぞ
entries.en:
Toshi. I never
taught you to
wield a sword for
revenge.

entries.jp: それで胸の痛みは\n治まるのか？
entries.en: Will that ease the\npain in your\nheart?

entries.jp: 復讐の道か誠の道か\n男が選ぶのは\nただ一本の道だ
entries.en:
The path of
revenge, or the
path of sincerity.
A man chooses
only one path.

entries.jp: お前はどっちを選ぶ気だ
entries.en: Which one do you\nmean to choose?

entries.jp: ただ一本の……
entries.en: Only one path...

entries.jp: 今なら選べる\nだがな　トシ
entries.en: You can still\nchoose now. But\nlisten, Toshi.

entries.jp: こんな事をやってれば\nお前の傷は\nいずれお前を呑み込む
entries.en:
If you keep doing
this, your wounds
will swallow you
whole one day.

entries.jp: 俺は……俺は
近藤さん　総司\n新選組のみんなと一緒に\n生きていきたい……
entries.en:
I want to live
alongside you,
Kondo-san, and
Soji, and
everyone in the
Shinsengumi...

entries.jp: でも傷がうずくんだ……
entries.en: But my wounds\nkeep aching...

entries.jp: だから俺がいるんだ\n総司がいるんだ\n友がいるんだ
entries.en:
That's why I'm
here. That's why
Soji's here. That's
why you have
friends.

entries.jp: 近藤さん……
entries.en: Kondo-san...
Friends...

entries.jp: 近藤さんが死んだら\n俺の友は誰なんだ？
entries.en: If you die,\nKondo-san, who's\nmy friend then?

entries.jp: 新選組の仲間か？\n総司だけか？\nそれとも……
entries.en: My Shinsengumi\ncomrades? Only\nSoji? Or...

entries.jp: 涙に濡れた土方の顔が\n龍馬達へと向けられた
entries.en:
Hijikata's
tear-soaked face
turned toward
Ryoma and the
others.

entries.jp: なあ近藤さん……\nまた教えてくれよ\nあの時みたいに
entries.en:
Hey, Kondo-san...
Teach me again.
Like you did back
then.

entries.jp: 近藤を抱きしめた\n土方の体に異変が\n起きたのはその時だ
entries.en:
It was then that
something
happened to
Hijikata's body as
he held Kondo.

entries.jp: なんじゃあ\nまた　あの光ぜよ！
entries.en: What the!? It's\nthat light again!

entries.jp: 今度は　土方と近藤が\n光ってるぜ！\nどういうこった
entries.en:
Now Hijikata and
Kondo are
glowing! What's
going on?

entries.jp: これは……\nこれはなんだ……？
entries.en: This is... What is\nthis...?

entries.jp:
それは超魂の欠片だった
近藤の体から浮かび
上がった片魂が
土方の内へと
吸い込まれていく
entries.en:
It was a fragment
of the Ultra Soul.
The Piece Soul
rose from Kondo's
body and was
drawn into
Hijikata.

entries.jp: こ……これは超魂の光？\n片魂が近藤さんから\n土方さんに移った
entries.en:
Th-this is the
light of the Ultra
Soul? The Piece
Soul moved from
Kondo-san to
Hijikata-san!

entries.jp: 土方さん……\nそれ……
entries.en: Hijikata-san...\nThat's...

entries.jp:
土方は愛しげに
光が吸い込まれた
場所を撫でる
繰り返し　繰り返し
entries.en:
Hijikata tenderly
stroked the spot
where the light
had been drawn
in. Again and
again.

entries.jp: 近藤さんが\n俺に泣くなと\n俺にくれた……んだ
entries.en: Kondo-san... gave\nit to me... telling\nme not to cry...

entries.jp: 間違わないようにと\n光を……
entries.en: ...A light... so I\nwouldn't lose my\nway...

entries.jp: いつだって……近藤さんは\n僕と土方さんの……光
entries.en:
Kondo-san was
always... the light
for me and
Hijikata-san...

entries.jp: そうだな……総司\nお前も　俺と行こう
entries.en: That's right... Soji.\nYou come with me\ntoo.

entries.jp: うん　近藤さんが……\n僕に命をくれた……もの
entries.en:
Yeah...
Kondo-san... gave
me my life, after
all.

entries.jp: ソウちん\n元気になっとる
entries.en: So-chin! You're\nlookin' better!

entries.jp: 近藤さんの　魂と　片魂の\n光が……力をくれた　から
entries.en:
Because
Kondo-san's soul...
and the light of
his Piece Soul...
gave me strength.

entries.jp: 俺たちは\nもう　近藤さんを\n嘆かせたりしない！
entries.en: We won't make\nKondo-san grieve\never again!

entries.jp: うん　そうだね\n土方さん
entries.en: Yeah, that's right,\nHijikata-san.

entries.jp: 近藤の亡骸を抱えた\n土方は力強く\n立ち上がった
entries.en:
Holding Kondo's
body, Hijikata
rose powerfully
to his feet.

entries.jp: 強い光が宿った瞳で\n龍馬や高杉　桂を\n見やる
entries.en:
With a strong
light dwelling in
his eyes, he
looked at Ryoma,
Takasugi, and
Katsura.

entries.jp: おい　坂本\nそろそろ立ち上がる時間だ
entries.en: Hey, Sakamoto.\nTime to get on\nyour feet.

entries.jp: なんじゃ　ヒジゾーさん\nわしらとやり合うのか？
entries.en:
What's this,
Hijizo-san? You
wanna throw
down with us?

entries.jp: いや\n井伊の操る暗黒の気と\n人形たちを　倒す！
entries.en:
No. We're taking
down the dark
energy and the
puppets Ii
controls.

entries.jp: あれを見ろ　坂本
entries.en: Look at that,\nSakamoto.

entries.jp: うおおっ？\n倒れていた奴らが　また\n起き上がったのかっ？
entries.en:
Whoa!? The guys
who went down
are getting back
up again!?

entries.jp: 別れの挨拶は見逃すと\n偉そうに言ってましたから\n見逃す時間はこれで終わり
entries.en:
He did say, so
grandly, that he'd
overlook a
farewell. So that
time is over now.

entries.jp: そういうことでしょう\nそして
entries.en: That's what it\nmeans, I suppose.\nAnd...

entries.jp: 井伊から受けた命を\n果たすまで――つまり\n俺達を殺すまで
entries.en:
Until they carry
out the order Ii
gave them--in
other words, until
they kill us...

entries.jp: 何度でも起き上がって\n襲ってくる
entries.en:
...they'll keep
getting up and
attacking, as
many times as it
takes.

entries.jp: 土方さん……僕も\nこんな風に人を\n操る歌を……
entries.en:
Hijikata-san... I
sang songs that
controlled people
like this, too...

entries.jp: それは言うな　総司\n俺たちは間違っていた\n
entries.en: Don't say it, Soji.\nWe were wrong.

entries.jp: 間違いは正せばいい
entries.en: Mistakes can be\nset right.

entries.jp: うん……
entries.en: Yeah...

entries.jp: ひとまずここを切り抜ける\nそれしかないね　土方さん
entries.en:
For now, we get
through this.
That's all we can
do, right,
Hijikata-san?

entries.jp: そういうことだ\nここを突破するぞ　坂本
entries.en:
That's right.
We're breaking
through,
Sakamoto.

entries.jp: うっしゃあ！\nわしも残った力で\nシャウトするんじゃ！
entries.en:
Hell yeah! I'll
shout with every
bit of strength I
got left!

entries.jp: ふん\n腰が抜けているくせに\nここは俺と総司に任せろ
entries.en:
Hmph. You can
barely stand.
Leave this to me
and Soji.

entries.jp: 新選組の仲間達はみんな\n洗脳されている
entries.en:
Our Shinsengumi
comrades have all
been
brainwashed.

entries.jp: 仲間のケジメは\n俺達でつける
entries.en:
We'll settle
accounts for our
own comrades
ourselves.

entries.jp: トサカくんはボロボロの\nスカシくんとメガネくんを\n頼むよ
entries.en:
Tosaka-kun, you
look after the
battered Mr.
Poser and
Glasses-kun.

entries.jp: オレ様は自力で動ける\n死にかけた沖田よりマシだ
entries.en:
Yours truly can
move on his own.
I'm in better
shape than the
half-dead Okita.

entries.jp: 私だって……\n傷だらけの土方さんよりは
entries.en:
Me too... I'm
better off than
the wounded
Hijikata-san, at
least.

entries.jp: いいんだ\n僕が歌って……\n道を開く！
entries.en: It's fine. I'll sing...\nand open the way!

entries.jp: 近藤さんや土方さん\nそれに……\nみんなのために！
entries.en: For Kondo-san,\nfor Hijikata-san...\nand for everyone!

entries.jp:
会場のあちこちで
立ち上がり束になって
襲い掛かる者達へ
沖田のシャウトが
降り注ぐ！
entries.en:
All across the
venue, people
rose up and
charged in a mob,
and Okita's shout
rained down upon
them!

entries.jp: 今度こそ僕は間違えない！\n僕は　本当の喜びを歌うよ\n聴いて　僕の歌
entries.en:
This time I won't
get it wrong! I'll
sing of true joy.
Listen... to my
song.

entries.jp: これが本当の僕の……\n歌いたい歌だ！
entries.en: This is the song I\ntruly... want to\nsing!

entries.jp: 近藤さん　あなたが僕の光\nだから聴いてください\n僕の　本当の　歌を！
entries.en:
Kondo-san, you
are my light. So
please, listen to
my true song!
